messages:
Mia Chen: Quick follow-up from the dedicated/private postmortem — I captured a short list of remediation items we need owners and timelines for. Please ack and assign.

Jon Patel: ACK, I can take the VPC peering checks and automation work. :thumbsup:

Sophia Lee: I'll own the on-prem constraints validation and the integration test matrix.

Rajiv Singh: I'll take the isolation-bug triage + patch and coordinate QA.

Mia Chen: Action items (high level):
1) VPC peering flakiness — add proactive validation & alerting, and a one-click remediation script. Owner: Jon Patel. Proposed ETA: 3 business days for validation/alerts, 10 business days for remediation script. Blockers: need customer network contact for test peering. Ticket: INF-4821
2) On-prem resource exhaustion during failover — runbook updates + expanded load tests (with customer's on-prem profile). Owner: Sophia Lee. ETA: 7 business days to produce test harness, 14 business days for runbook + fixes. Ticket: INF-4822
3) Isolation bug (kernel namespace leak) — triage → patch → canary → rollout. Owner: Rajiv Singh. ETA: 48–72h for triage, 1 week for patch+canary. Ticket: INF-4823
4) Postmortem follow-up cadence — assign an owner to drive weekly check-ins for 30 days to catch recurring patterns. Owner: Mia Chen. ETA: start tomorrow, weekly notes in #incidents
5) Customer communication: consolidate remediation ETA and rollback options and send to CS and customer. Owner: Customer Success. ETA: EOD today

Jon Patel: Quick notes on 1): pattern shows peering flaps correlate with BGP session restarts triggered by nightly config pushes. We should add a BGP session stability monitor and a prefailure alert window (5min flaps -> ticket). Also will add a small script:

```
# quick VPC sanity
aws ec2 describe-route-tables --filters "Name=tag:deployment,Values=dedicated" --query 'RouteTables[*].Routes'
``` 
Will open GH PR for automation.

Sophia Lee: For 2) I need sample on-prem manifests from the customer (cpu/mem limits, cgroups). CS, can you share? Also propose adding a stress test job that mimics the customer's batch windows.

Customer Success: Sharing manifests now — uploaded to secure drive link (private). Will DM access.

Rajiv Singh: For 3) initial triage found a namespace refcount edge case in our isolation manager. Repro steps in INF-4823. Prioritizing a minimal patch to unref stray namespaces on container exit. Will request a canary on dedicated pool only.

Mia Chen: Please add the following to each ticket: owner, ETA, acceptance criteria (how we verify fix), rollback plan, and post-deploy monitoring query. We need clear exit criteria for the 30-day cadence.

Jon Patel: Added acceptance criteria to INF-4821: automated peering self-heal triggers and <1min failover time verified across 5 simulated peering drops. Will add monitoring dashboard and alert.

Sophia Lee: INF-4822 acceptance: stress tests show no resource exhaustion for 48h under customer's peak pattern. Runbook includes steps to scale and a script to snapshot metrics. PR will update runbook doc.

Rajiv Singh: INF-4823 acceptance: reproduced in staging, patch stops leak across 100 container restarts. Canary log shipping validated. Rollback is to revert to previous isolation manager binary and force drain.

Mia Chen: Ops-Bot, can you create the weekly recurring check-in event and add a calendar invite for the next 4 weeks with owners? :calendar:

Ops-Bot: Created event "PM Follow-up: Dedicated/Private VPC & Isolation" starting tomorrow 10:00 for 4 weekly occurrences. Invite sent to participants.

Jon Patel: I'll open GH issue + PR for the validation scripts by EOD tomorrow. :eyes:

Sophia Lee: Will schedule the stress test run next Tue and post results in this thread.

Rajiv Singh: Planning canary rollout Thursday afternoon in dedicated pool. Will post canary ID and telemetry link.

Mia Chen: Thanks all. Final ask: each owner paste a 1-line status update in this thread at EOD tomorrow so we can sync before the calendar start. :white_check_mark:

Jon Patel: EOD status will be posted.

Sophia Lee: EOD status will be posted.

Rajiv Singh: EOD status will be posted.

Customer Success: Confirmed customer notified of ETA and rollback options. Will escalate if they request a faster window.

Mia Chen: Closing for now — will re-open if anything urgent pops up. :pray:
